audit.why: 54.81% over 312 games with the chart reading Galio through level 6 and Master Yi from first item — the shape matches the number, so no side or rating changed. What was missing was the mechanical reason behind each swing.
audit.corrected: Difficulty framing kept; every phase now carries the interaction that causes it.

audit.whatIsWrong: Not a single cooldown appears anywhere in the entry — the packet flagged 'NO cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere' and it was accurate.
audit.why: Alpha Strike is 20/19.5/19/18.5/18 — one of the longest ability cooldowns in the game at rank 1 — and Riot notes 'Basic attacks reduce Alpha Strike's cooldown.' Meditate is a flat 10s, Wuju Style 14s, Highlander 85s.
audit.corrected: The all-in window is now keyed to a spent Alpha Strike, with the 20s stated in spikes[1] and early.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing says Alpha Strike is untargetable, and nothing says Meditate is a channel.
audit.why: Riot on Alpha Strike: 'teleports across the battlefield with blinding speed... while simultaneously becoming UNTARGETABLE.' Riot on Meditate: it is a channel that restores health and reduces damage taken. A taunt or a knockup ends a channel.
audit.corrected: Alpha Strike goes clean through the punch and the taunt release; Meditate is cancelled outright by the Shield of Durand taunt or the Hero's Entrance knockup. Written into whys[2], whys[6], late and wants.you[0].

audit.whatIsWrong: Highlander is never mentioned, leaving the reader to assume the late-game taunt is unreliable.
audit.why: Riot: Highlander makes him 'immune to all SLOWING effects' — slow immunity, not crowd-control immunity. Shield of Durand's taunt and Hero's Entrance's knockup still land through it, on an 85-second ultimate.
audit.corrected: Stated in spikes[3] and late so the teamfight plan has a reason to trust the taunt.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two strings say his true damage 'ignores W's magic reduction', implying the fix is more magic resist.
audit.why: Wuju Style grants bonus TRUE damage on basic attacks and Alpha Strike deals PHYSICAL damage. Neither is magic, so magic resist is the wrong purchase for the entire matchup — armour and health are the answer.
audit.corrected: Rewritten as an itemization instruction in spikes[2], whys[5], mid and wants.you[2].

notes: IMPORTANT STRUCTURAL FINDING: there is no 'masteryi' key in CHAMP_FULL.galio (champ-data/galio.full.js has 71 entries and Master Yi is not one of them), so this matchup has a content layer but no full layer. All edits are content-only; if the front end renders the full layer for this matchup it is rendering nothing. Mechanically the entry was the packet's worst for sequencing — zero cooldowns anywhere — while Alpha Strike sits at 20 seconds at rank 1, which is the whole all-in window. Also corrected the itemization logic: two strings framed Yi's true damage as beating 'W's magic reduction', which nudges the reader toward more MR, when in fact Wuju Style is true and Alpha Strike is physical so magic resist is wrong for the entire matchup. Added the two interactions that decide teamfights: Alpha Strike is untargetable, and Highlander is slow immunity rather than CC immunity, so the taunt still lands.
